look_here_first: At three or more FRESH stem nodes and growing tips look for LONG WHITE silky TUFTS emerging between leaves (axillary trichomes); then check many slender, FLESHY near-cylindrical/semicylindrical sharp-tipped leaves. The capsule is unwinged, unlike P. umbraticola. Flower often bright pink or purple but never use color alone; long hairs may fall from old nodes.

morphology_keys.habit: Annual often low trailing or slightly ascending succulent stems 3–25 cm, fibrous to slightly fleshy root.
morphology_keys.leaves: Narrow linear to oblong-lanceolate, subterete to hemispheric (partly round) blades usually 5–20 × 1–3 mm, often sharp pointed tips.
morphology_keys.flowers: Usually 5–12 mm diam with pink-purple petal lobes, petals ephemeral; flower color supports but is not proof.
morphology_keys.fruits: Small unwinged circumscissile capsule 1.5–4.3 mm diam; 6–9 flower-subtending leaflike leaves frequently clustered near tips.
morphology_keys.seeds: Very small black/lead-colored seeds around 0.4–0.6 mm with short tubercles and stellate-rounded seed surface cells; high-resolution microscopy needed.
morphology_keys.axils: Long conspicuous white hair tufts at young nodes and inflorescences, diagnostic when combined with leaf cross-section and capsule.
best_field_traits: REAL white fluffy hair tufts at several fresh leaf axils, unlike mostly nearly hairless oleracea/umbraticola.
Narrow pointed succulent leaves approximately half-cylindrical to round in section.
Unwinged capsule; umbraticola requires membranous circular wing below seam.
Small black seeds need ≥20×/microscopy; never infer sculpture from flower close-up.
Cultivar and nonlocal species photos demonstrate morphology only, not county nativity.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Pilosa: narrow subterete/semicylindrical blades + conspicuous white axillary hair tufts and no wing. Oleracea: broad flat spatulate leaves and less obvious trichomes. Umbraticola: even flattened leaves with mature winged capsule. Some other Portulaca have narrow leaves/hairs; fine seed sculpture and fruit should verify.
